data.name: Overscope
data.detailed_description:
The game is planned for 2027.
Screenshots will be updated over time!
The Demo is planned for this year!

A high speed multiplayer extraction shooter with ultra smooth gunplay, fast movement, and fully randomized indoor raids.

Every run is different. Every corridor is a risk. Every item you extract could shape your next raid.

This game blends the tension and loot driven survival of an extraction shooter with the speed of classic arena movement and a progression system that keeps every successful run meaningful.

Features

High FPS gameplay built for speed

The game is designed around responsiveness, fluid combat, and extremely smooth performance. Fast reactions, clean gunplay, and a high FPS feel are at the core of the experience.

Fast, casual friendly movement

Movement is easy to pick up, but fast and satisfying to master.

A new map every raid

The map is entirely indoor, but every time you start a match, it is procedural / randomly generated.

Different rooms and hallways spawn and connect in new ways, creating a fresh layout every run.

Loot, extract, level up

Whatever you find and successfully extract with is yours to keep. Finish a raid and earn both loot and EXP to grow stronger over time.

Unlock better rooms, find better loot

As you level up, you unlock new room types and can choose in the menu which rooms are allowed to spawn in future raids. Better rooms mean a better chance at higher value loot.

Create your own character

The game features a character creator that lets you build a male or female character and customize your appearance with different skin tones, hairstyles, and cosmetic options

5 combat classes, 3 professions, levelable skills

Choose your preferred combat style from five weapon classes:

Rifle

SMG

Sniper

LMG

Shotgun

Support your playstyle further with three professions, each with levelable skills:

Hacker

Electrician

Medic

Bots that behave like real players

The AI is not meant to feel like standard NPC enemies. Bots have their own goals. They enter the raid, search for loot, move through the map, and try to extract, just like players.

They do not automatically hunt you down. If you leave them alone, they may leave you alone. But if you attack them, they will fight back. Some bots may extract early with valuable loot. Others might even camp an exit.

Kill them, loot everything

If you take down a bot, you can loot everything it was carrying, including all weapons, gear, and equipment.

Upgrade every item

Every item in the game can be upgraded. Instead of using a complicated weapon modding system, you improve gear directly with upgrade items.

For example, upgrading a weapon can reduce its recoil. Simple, direct, and focused on progression.

The Goal

Enter the raid.

Find valuable loot.

Survive.

Extract.

Unlock stronger rooms, better items, and more specialized skills.

Every run is a gamble.

Every room can make you rich.

And every exit might already be watched.

data.short_description: Fast. Brutal. A High FPS extraction shooter with randomized indoor raids, aggressive loot progression, player like bots, and upgradeable gear. Enter rich zones, grab what you can, and make it out alive or lose it all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
